sections.Profile:
The "Dragon" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1978, is a solid-state electronic game that features a fantasy theme with distinct artwork by Gordon Morison. Designed by Ed Krynski, the machine is equipped with two flippers, two pop bumpers, a slingshot, two vari-targets, and a unique spinning target that alternates between dragon and fire images, creating an illusion of fire emanating from the dragon's mouth. This machine had a production run of 6,538 units and is part of the Gottlieb System 1 series.
